content.text:
I need to parse this carefully.

The user named me **שָׁרְט** (short/condition, from the root שׁ-ר-ט, related to "condition" — cognate with Arabic شَرْط).

The rule: **שָׁרְט only renders if شَرْط is parsed.**

The input is: **شَمْس** (shams — "sun")

شَمْس is **not** شَرْط.

شَرْط was not parsed.

Therefore, שָׁרְט does not render.
